address.note: Street, city, state and ZIP agree across all sources. Only the unit number differs - three values. try.southdademusic.com contradicts itself: text says Unit 115, its own map link resolves to unit 117.

openingHours.note: Hours appear ONLY in the footer. They are absent from /contact-enroll/ body and from try.southdademusic.com. No holiday schedule, no term dates, no closure calendar published.
openingHours.unverified: Instrument pages repeatedly promise 'After-school and evening availability'. Evening availability past 6:00pm is not supported by the published hours.

serviceArea.note: Identical sentence on five pages: 'We serve families in Florida City, Homestead, Cutler Bay, Palmetto Bay, and nearby areas.' Instrument pages instead use the vaguer 'South Dade and nearby communities'.

ageGroups.gap: No summer option exists for ages 3-6; camp floor is 7.

languages.claim: Yes. A large portion of our families are Spanish-speaking... We offer full bilingual support across our core programs and enrollment processes so Spanish-only parents have complete clarity.
sources: homepage Step Up block ('Spanish language support available')
languages.note: CRITICAL GAP: the claim of 'full bilingual support across our core programs and enrollment processes' is not evidenced anywhere. There is no Spanish version of any page, no language switcher, no hreflang tag, and the external booking widget was not verified for Spanish. One testimonial is in Spanish (Maria carolina Linares). The claim as written is not currently supported by the website.
